action: He checks the solar battery readout in the cab, eyes tracking the voltage: 56%, steady, no drain overnight.
thought: Systems are holding. We're still safe.

action: She brings two cups of hot water to the cab, setting one beside Dan while her eyes settle on the food log open on the seat.
thought: Sixty days. Maybe less if luck turns.

description: In the cab of the van, Dan and Hui Ling stand with their cups in the morning sun, the rooftop spread bright behind them, the dead city visible far below in the clear light.

dialogue.speaker: huiling
dialogue.line: How long on the food stores?

dialogue.speaker: huiling
dialogue.line: We've been careful for months, Dan.

dialogue.speaker: dan
dialogue.line: And we're alive. That's the math.

dialogue.speaker: huiling
dialogue.line: I know. I just feel it running down.
